project.name: Henschke Winery Ecommerce & Brand Website
project.description: Supported the development and maintenance of the official website and ecommerce experience for Henschke, one of Australia’s oldest family-owned wineries established in 1868. Contributed to frontend development, ecommerce functionality, responsive UX improvements, and performance optimization for a premium wine brand platform focused on storytelling, sustainability, and online wine sales.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained responsive frontend components for the winery ecommerce platform
Supported Shopify-based ecommerce features and customer purchasing flows
Implemented UI/UX enhancements for premium brand presentation
Optimized website performance and page loading experience
Integrated marketing and analytics tools for customer engagement
Supported SEO optimization and structured metadata improvements
Worked on reusable frontend functionality and interactive experiences
Maintained PHP-based integrations and backend support systems
Enhanced mobile responsiveness across ecommerce and content pages
Collaborated on sustainability and brand storytelling presentation pages
highlights: Supported a premium winery ecommerce platform with global brand presence
Contributed to modern ecommerce UX and responsive frontend experiences
Improved performance and scalability for online wine sales
Enhanced customer engagement through marketing integrations
Supported digital storytelling for sustainability and winery heritage
